evidence_span.text: siRNA-mediated down-regulation of MOSC2 and the mitochondrial form of cytochrome b(5) type B (CYB5B) significantly inhibited the reductase activity in the differentiated adipocytes

reviews.rationale: siRNA knockdown of CYB5B directly reduced amidoxime reductase activity important for lipid synthesis, causally supporting the mechanism's claim about CYB5B in this system. The functional (siRNA) experiments were done in differentiated 3T3-L1 adipocytes, not hepatocytes, so context is indirect rather than the declared partial, though liver outer mitochondrial membrane was used for initial biochemical characterization.
